links.outcome: Whether GPT-4 without context gave outdated guideline recommendations after guideline update
links.effect: Without context GPT-4 mostly adhered to the older 2015 WHO guidelines; only 51% of recommendations were coherent with the 2024 guidelines.

links.outcome: Currency of LLM clinical knowledge versus current guidelines
links.effect: GPT-4 without external context gave outdated treatment recommendations for chronic hepatitis B; coherence was 51%, and errors persisted (91%) even with context.
links.quote: Consequently, this setup allowed us to specifically isolate and demonstrate the impact of providing access to an up‐to‐date external document, effectively showcasing GPT‐4's vulnerability to providing outdated or incorrect treatment recommendations without immediate contextualisation.
